seo.title: Plan your trip to Madagascar, the budget follows
seo.description: Build your Madagascar itinerary stop by stop: lodging, meals, transport and activities. The budget is recounted with every choice, in total and per person.
seo.imageAlt: Zeboo. Compose your trip, the budget follows. The RN7 trail, from Antananarivo to Ranohira.

footer.rights: Zeboo, an independent trip planner for Madagascar.

hero.title: Compose your trip.
hero.lead: Zeboo assembles your Madagascar itinerary, stop by stop, and recounts the spend at every choice. In total, and per person.

steps.title: From the idea to the road,
steps.lead: There is nothing to learn. You search, you add, you go.
steps.oneBody: Filter by type, by region, by town, or let Zeboo show you what is near you.
steps.twoBody: A town, a number of nights, and under it the hotel, the table, the activity. The days count themselves.
steps.threeBody: Your circuit, its budget and its road follow you on the track, even when the network leaves.

budget.title: The total climbs.
budget.lead: This is the heart of Zeboo. Change the number of travellers and watch both figures answer: the room and the vehicle are shared, the meal and the entry are bought per head.
budget.once: The division happens once, at the end, so the share never drifts from the total it came from.
budget.lodgingNote: {nights, plural, one {# night, shared} other {# nights, shared}}
budget.mealsNote: {meals, plural, one {# meal, per person} other {# meals, per person}}

compose.title: A stop, its nights,
compose.lead: You pick the towns you sleep in. Zeboo works out the days, traces the road between them, and counts what you set down.

discover.title: Madagascar,
discover.lead: Stays, tables, activities, campsites, rentals and guides. Every listing carries its price bracket and its position on the map.

transport.title: Three ways to move,
transport.ownBody: Give your consumption. Zeboo takes the distance by road, not as the crow flies, and draws the fuel from it.
transport.carrierBody: The companies serving your line first. Every fare carries its source and its date.
transport.rentalBody: The norm in Madagascar. The renter's daily rate, shared between you.

road.title: The map comes down
road.lead: Press Navigate and the screen changes trade: the map tilts, turns the way you are heading, and an arrow says where you are going.
road.pointOne: The manoeuvre ahead, and how far off it is.
road.pointTwo: What is left in kilometres and in order of magnitude, never an arrival time promised.
road.pointThree: Out in the bush, the itinerary, the distances and the budget stay readable.

doors.agencyTitle: Would rather not organise it all?
doors.agencyBody: Agencies publish their ready made circuits, at the firm price they announce. You start from there and adjust it, or you take it as it is.
doors.providerTitle: Do you make the trip happen?
doors.providerBody: Hotel, table, guide, renter: publish your listing, set your point on the map, and receive travellers' enquiries directly.

promises.title: Four promises
promises.oneBody: A posted tariff is an indication for that kind of service in that region. Only an agency circuit's price is firm.
promises.twoBody: A provider does not declare itself verified. An administrator checks the listing before it goes public.
promises.threeBody: Neither number nor address is exposed. Putting people in touch happens inside Zeboo.
promises.fourBody: Nothing is scraped from anywhere. Open data, official sites, and entry by hand, with the source and the date.

questions.title: What we get asked
questions.oneA: No. They are indicative brackets, meant to give you an order of magnitude before you leave. Only the price of a circuit offered by an agency is a firm price, announced by them.
questions.twoA: By the road that can actually be driven, not as the crow flies. Between Antsirabe and Ranohira that is 523 km of tarmac against 343 in a straight line, and it is the first figure that counts for your fuel.
questions.threeQ: Does it work without a network?
questions.threeA: Your itinerary, your distances and your budget stay readable when the connection leaves. The map tiles, though, need to have been loaded.
questions.fourA: The verified badge is granted by an administrator, never self declared.
questions.fiveA: The Android version comes out first. The iPhone follows.

download.title: Ready for the RN7.
download.lead: Compose your trip tonight, leave tomorrow, and keep the budget in sight all the way.
download.androidUnknownSource: The file comes from Zeboo and not from the Play Store: when you open it, Android will ask you to allow installing from this source. It is a one time switch.
